cape-town-western-cape-chapman-s-peak-an.speedBand: 50–80 km/h riding core, local limits always win

sections.advice: This Scenic stretch near Kraaifontein → High point near Stellenbosch stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

Photo stop near Retreat → Constantia is the technical section. Hairpins, gradients and mixed traffic can stack up quickly; use low drama inputs, stay wide of centre lines and expect buses or riders appearing exactly where optimism says they will not.

waypoints.advice: Bealach na Ba comes up 115 km in. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Applecross, mostly downhill.

sections.advice: Inverness → Bealach na Ba climbs about 626 m in 115 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Bealach na Ba → Applecross drops about 626 m over 5 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Applecross → Ullapool is 80 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.
Ullapool → Durness is 98 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.

scenicChapters.title: Inverness → Bealach na Ba
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 177 km. 626 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: North Coast 500
scenicChapters.narrative: 626 m come off over 7 km at around 13.2%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

north-coast-500-inverness-durness.story: A one-way ride of 461 km, Inverness to the finish - roughly 6 h 39 in the saddle. It goes by way of Bealach na Ba, Applecross and Ullapool. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
